signals.title: MODENAS, KOLEJ KEDA LAUNCH EV MOTORCYCLE CENTRE OF EXCELLENCE
signals.summary: Collaboration establishes first dedicated EV motorcycle centre of excellence in Kedah to strengthen TVET development SIK, KEDAH, 20 September 2026 – Motosikal dan Enjin Nasional Sdn Bhd (“MODENAS”), a member of the DRB-HICOM Group, and Kolej KEDA today launched the EV Motorcycle Industry–Academia Centre of Excellence (EV-MIACE), strengthening collaboration between the industry, and technical and vocational education and training (TVET) in electric motorcycle technology. Located at the Motorcycle Technology Department of Kolej KEDA in Sik, Kedah, the initiative positions Kolej KEDA as the first college in Kedah to collaborate with MODENAS in implementing the EV Motorcycle Centre of Excellence, a dedicated centre aimed at further integrating industry knowledge, technology and technical expertise into TVET education. Under the collaboration, students will gain exposure to MODENAS’s electric motorcycle systems, while MODENAS will provide advisory support for the development of Kolej KEDA’s EV motorcycle teaching and learning module, share current technology and technical expertise, as well as contribute learning equipment. Students undertaking the module will also receive skills recognition and certification from MODENAS. Roslan Roskan, Chief Executive Officer of MODENAS, said, “As motorcycle technology continues to evolve, developing the right technical capabilities is very important. Through EV-MIACE, MODENAS and Kolej KEDA are bringing industry and education closer together to

signals.title: Triumph TF 250-X: the MX2 champion evolves for 2027
signals.summary: Following its strong performance in the MX2 World Championship, Triumph is refreshing the TF 250-X for the 2027 season. The new version of the bike introduces a series of innovations developed in a racing context , with targeted improvements to the engine, chassis and components. The 249.9 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke engine retains a claimed power output of 48 CV at 13,500 rpm, complemented by new electronic calibration that optimises throttle response, power delivery smoothness and torque management. The powertrain also features new valve guides, updated clutch components and a new selector drum, to improve gear-shifting precision, durability and consistency. Significant updates have also been made to the Kayaba suspension , with revised settings and new tool-free adjustment mechanisms. The 48 mm AOS fork and the monoshock with separate reservoir are paired with new Neken steering heads made from 7075-T6 aluminium, featuring recalibrated stiffness. The specification also includes a Brembo braking system with Galfer discs, a ProTaper ACF handlebar, dual engine mapping, Launch Control, Traction Control and Quickshifter. signals.title: Zero Motorcycles celebrates two decades with exclusive SR/F and fresh paint schemes
signals.summary: Zero Motorcycles is revving up two decades of electric evolution. To celebrate its 20th anniversary, the pioneering brand is unleashing a limited-run version of the SR/F , alongside fresh colorways across its entire street and dual sport lineups . Back when the SR/F first roared onto the scene in 2019, it completely rewrote the rulebook for Zero. Built from the ground up as a revolutionary platform, it fused the cutting-edge Z-Force powertrain, the brainy Cypher III operating system, Bosch Motorcycle Stability Control, and an all-new chassis architecture—forging a machine engineered purely for raw performance, absolute control, and digital connectivity. Fast forward seven years, and it remains a pure, unfiltered expression of Zero’s founding vision. Today's SR/F churns out a thrilling 190 Nm of torque and 83 kW of power, delivering lightning-fast electric throttle response for a ride that feels intensely athletic, razor-sharp, and totally wired to the rider. The SR/F 20th Anniversary Edition takes this legacy to the next level with a stealthy Jet Black and gold aesthetic, decked out with top-tier premium components. True to its collector status, only 20 units will ever hit select European showrooms , and each one comes bundled with an exclusive, limited-edition 20th Anniversary gear bag. signals.title: Stylmartin Reed, the ultimate technical sneaker for urban riders
signals.summary: Leading the charge for the brand’s 2027 collection debuting at EICMA, the Stylmartin Reed technical sneaker boasts a high-top, wraparound silhouette engineered for ultimate ankle stability. Packed with top-tier features, the shoe integrates internal PU ankle guards , a tonal leather gear shifter pad, a shock-absorbing micro-perforated anatomic insole, and subtle reflective inserts. Its rugged Vibram extra-light EVA lug sole delivers exceptional grip and featherlight comfort whether you are tearing up the asphalt or walking the streets. Finished with dual-color lace options and understated branding, its design transitions seamlessly off the bike. The Reed is available in two distinct versions: the WP , crafted from sleek black nubuck leather with a waterproof membrane designed to conquer cold and rainy days, and the AIR , rendered in a striking petrol hue with a breathable air mesh lining built for milder climates.
